decisions.text: type bar: the pattern across ordered categories is the message, but many readers take any line for change over time, so a line is only for a data-savvy audience (audience.data_savvy; 08-12 DP-2, G1.58): bars, in the categories' order
ordinal categories in their given order
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart (wrapped: Visited website, Downloaded trial, Contacted support): vertical bars
5 values against 6 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: 9,152, 6,681, 5,211, 2,658, 2,126 (G6.16, G7.4)
wrapped onto two lines: Visited website, Downloaded trial, Contacted support
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “prospects”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
the title wraps onto two lines
